search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
Direct ranking evidence and company-reported airbag share were found; further search was unnecessary. The support is bounded to the source date and 2023 share figure.
The direct ranking statement is from Moody’s Ratings, a secondary source; Autoliv’s own report corroborates its worldwide automotive-safety leadership and reports a 47% airbag share.
Autoliv identifies its market-share figures as company estimates. The cited materials do not specify the airbag-market denominator or whether the share is measured by revenue or units.
The claim has no stated period; evidence supports the ranking as stated in the July 2024 source, not necessarily at a later date.
